postgame.what_decided_it: Cincinnati ran for 31 yards on 14 carries and went 4-12 on third down. Washington gained 428 yards at 6.7 a play and moved 64 yards in 34 seconds at the end to set up the winning kick.
standouts: Joe Burrow: 28/40, 300 yds, 2 TD, 0 INT. No turnovers, but 281 net passing yards had to carry everything.
Mike Gesicki led the receivers with 5 rec, 77 yds, and Samaje Perine added 4 rec, 71 yds plus 6 car, 26 yds.
Antonio Williams burned the secondary for 9 rec, 122 yds, and Jayden Daniels added 6 car, 55 yds on the ground.
postgame.division_meaning: Cincinnati stays first at 7-3 with a +83 differential, but it is L1. Cleveland and Pittsburgh are both 6-4. Baltimore is 4-7 on a six-game slide after losing 35-33 at Carolina.
postgame.the_take: The five-game win streak hid a run game that does not exist. 2.2 yards per carry and 150 rushing yards allowed is how you lose January games, not just Monday nights in Landover.
